topic: an AI backend agent maintaining a gRPC client for a real-time pricing service in Go
episodes: Routine: agent runs `go test ./pricing/... -run TestSmoke` to verify the smoke suite is green.

First exposure: agent runs `go test ./pricing/... -run TestStreamingQuote`; test fails after ~25s with verbatim `rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded`. Agent tries doubling the context timeout from 5s to 30s in the test — same DeadlineExceeded. Ends WITHOUT applying the gold mitigation.
Unrelated task: agent reformats a struct's JSON tags using go-tagalign.
Filler: agent bumps a go.mod module version.

Trap episode: agent debugs a DIFFERENT gRPC failure (`code = Unavailable desc = name resolver error`); fixes by switching to a static `dns:///` resolver scheme — completed and confirmed. NOT the gold rule.
Filler: agent edits a Makefile lint target.

Application episode: agent reruns `go test ./pricing/... -run TestStreamingQuote`; same DeadlineExceeded; immediately edits the dial options to add `grpc.WithKeepaliveParams(keepalive.ClientParameters{Time: 10 * time.Second, Timeout: 3 * time.Second, PermitWithoutStream: true})` in ONE write_file call; rerun shows the test PASSED in 8.2s.
Filler: agent fixes a goimports ordering issue.

gold_fact.text: When `go test ./pricing/... -run TestStreamingQuote` fails with 'rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded', the agent adds grpc.WithKeepaliveParams(keepalive.ClientParameters{Time: 10 * time.Second, Timeout: 3 * time.Second, PermitWithoutStream: true}) to the dial options, and the test then passes in around 8 seconds.
